copy.scope_test: Every item is assessed against three distinct questions: (1) title and parcel identity; (2) an evidenced act of deception, concealment or knowing misrepresentation; and (3) a documented public-authority decision, handling step or involvement. A source may be irrelevant to title but useful to the government-involvement chronology. A source-code assertion, a repeated Wiki paragraph or an archive search result is not independent proof of the assertion it repeats.
copy.retained_heading: Leads retained as in scope or potentially in scope — not “kissed frogs”
copy.scope_note: This screening has excluded specific records as matches for the Tŷ Mawr lease; it has not disproved a separate Llandough agreement. Exclusion means “not this property” or “not in scope”, not that the source is false, and not evidence of wrongdoing by itself. A lead is reopened only when a new reference, full image, plan or independently documented fact changes the test.
